scope: CAP-039 / CAP-040 mock-sensor generation and cleanup scope
changes: Demo setup marks inserted sample devices and adopts existing devices only when name, manufacturer, model, and serial number match the stable sample identity.
Mock generation selects only active devices marked as mock_sensor_demo.
Cleanup deletes alerts and mock readings only for marked demo devices; device registry rows remain to preserve dependent references.
Cleanup rolls back and closes the connection if either delete fails.

pytest.command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_mock_sensors_cleanup.py tests/test_mock_sensors_cli.py tests/test_mock_sensor_error_redaction.py tests/test_iot_sensor_push.py -q

database_access: none; all database interactions were mocked
limitations: Demo sensor registry rows are retained rather than deleted so telemetry, alert, and claim references are not broken.
This does not establish live PostgreSQL behavior or production sensor inventory parity.
